text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though the weather is so lovely... 
Rice is just... *sigh*.

While walking through the park on my day 
off, I spotted Rice Shower with her 
shoulders slumped.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Onii-sama... Um, it's nothing big, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Onee-sama... Um, it's nothing big, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I came all the way out here to sketch the 
scenery, but I forgot my sketchbook..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Since I had no choice, I went around to 
shops to buy it, but it was sold out 
everywhere... *sigh*

Looking downcast, Rice Shower gazed out at 
the beautiful water glistening in the 
sun...
